question: In India the 1st census was held in the year ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __1872__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A population census is a method by which demographic, social, cultural and economic data relating to each and every person in that country are compiled, collected, analysed and disseminated at a specific time over 10 years.
 
• The first census was conducted in India in 1872, but the regular census started in **1881**.
 
• The first census in all of India was conducted by the British Raj authorities. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The 15th Census of India and the 7th Census of Independent India-2011 were started on 1st April 2010 with President being the first citizen to be enumerated, followed by the Vice President of India.
 
• The slogan of Census 2011 was ‘Our Census, Our future’.
 
• C. Chandramouli was the Census Commissioner of India in 2011.
 
• The population of the nation as per the provisional figures of Census **2011 is 1210.19 million of which 623.7 million (51.54%) are males and 586.46 million (48.46%) are females.**
 
• Uttar Pradesh is the most populous state in India its population is more than the population of Brazil.
 
• Thus, **the first census started in 1872.**
